blurb: Bittersweet Golf Club is an 18-hole championship golf course owned by the Village of Gurnee, IL. The course features mature hardwood trees, wetlands, native prairies, and abundant wildlife. It offers a public course experience comparable to a private country club, with practice range and dining facilities.
